title: Shakespeare's Globe Theatre
examples: What was the Globe Theatre like when it was first built?
Can you describe the audience at the Globe?
Did they use electricity at the Globe?

explain.say: The Globe Theatre first opened in the year fifteen ninety nine.
Standing in the yard were the groundlings who paid a small price to watch.
The stage area was a very important part of the theatre design.
Shakespeare wrote many popular plays that were performed in the open air.
Imagine watching a play on a sunny afternoon at the Globe.
A common mistake is thinking the theatre was covered all the time.

faq.q: Was the Globe Theatre always open to the public?
faq.a: Yes, it was designed for a large audience to gather outside. It was an open-air venue for performances.
asks: Where did people stand to watch plays?
Was the theatre indoors or outdoors?

faq.a: The groundlings were the audience members who stood in the open yard area. They paid a small fee to get a good view.
asks: Who were the people standing outside?
Did everyone sit in the theatre?

faq.a: The stage was the main platform where the actors performed the scenes. It was a key part of the theatre's structure.
asks: What was the main performance area called?

faq.q: Did they use modern lighting at the Globe?
faq.a: No, the theatre relied on natural light from the open air. Performances were lit by the sun during the day.

faq.q: What kind of plays were shown there?
faq.a: Shakespeare wrote many popular plays that were performed there. These plays covered many different stories and themes.
asks: Were the plays always about history?

facts: The Globe Theatre opened in London in the year fifteen ninety nine.
The groundlings were audience members who stood in the open yard.
The stage was the primary area for the actors' performances.
The theatre was designed to operate in the open air.

quiz.say: The Globe Theatre first opened in:
quiz.why: The text states the theatre opened in the year fifteen ninety nine.

wrong.0: This is close, but the text specifies the exact opening year.
wrong.1: This date is incorrect; the opening year was later.
wrong.2: This year is too late for the original Globe Theatre.

quiz.say: Who were the people who stood in the yard?
quiz.why: The groundlings were the specific name for the standing audience members.

wrong.0: Patrons usually refer to wealthier, seated audience members.
wrong.1: Boxholders were those who paid for private boxes.
wrong.2: While correct generally, 'groundlings' is the specific term used.

quiz.say: What was the main performance area called?
quiz.why: The stage was the designated area where the actors carried out the play.

wrong.1: The pit was generally the area below the stage, not the performance area itself.
wrong.2: The yard was where the groundlings stood, not the stage.
wrong.3: This is too general; 'The Stage' is the specific term.
